functions: Capital gain or loss on each parcel a sale takes, first in, first out, with the 12-month test

/*  FUNCTION NAME:  CGTParcelsλ
    DESCRIPTION:*//**Capital gain or loss on each parcel of shares or units a sale takes, first in, first out, and whether the parcel was held 12 months for the CGT discount*/
/*  SOURCE:         Income Tax Assessment Act 1997, compilation 264 (21 May 2026), volume 3, read 22 November 2026:
                    https://www.legislation.gov.au/C2004A05138/2026-05-21/2026-05-21/text/original/pdf/3
                    s 115-25(1): a discount capital gain must be on a CGT asset acquired at least 12 months
                    before the CGT event.
                    ATO, 'CGT discount', last updated 29 June 2026, read 22 November 2026: 'You exclude the day
                    of acquisition and the day of the CGT event'. The CGT event for a sale under contract
                    happens on the contract date:
                    https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/investments-and-assets/capital-gains-tax/cgt-discount
                    ATO, TD 33, paragraph 4, read 22 November 2026: for identical shares that cannot be told
                    apart, the Commissioner accepts 'first-in first-out' or the taxpayer's selection:
                    https://www.ato.gov.au/law/view/document?DocID=CGD/TD33/NAT/ATO/00001
                    Treasury Laws Amendment (Tax Reform No. 1) Act 2026 (No. 49, 2026), Schedule 1 items 82 to 84,
                    read 22 November 2026: its CGT changes apply from 1 July 2027, so a later sale is refused:
                    https://www.legislation.gov.au/C2026A00049/asmade/text
*/
CGTParcelsλ = LAMBDA(
//  Parameter Declaration
    [Parcels],
    [Sales],
    LET(
    //  Help
        Help,           TRIM(TEXTSPLIT(
                            "FUNCTION:      →CGTParcelsλ(Parcels, Sales)¶" &
                            "DESCRIPTION:   →Capital gain or loss on each parcel a sale takes, first in, first out.¶NOTES!         →Returns a header row and one row for each parcel a sale takes units from:¶               →the sale and acquisition dates, the units, their share of the sale's¶               →proceeds and of the parcel's cost base, the capital gain or loss, and TRUE¶               →under 12 months when the parcel was acquired at least 12 months before the¶               →sale, counting neither day (ITAA 1997 s 115-25(1)). Sales take the earliest¶               →parcels first, which TD 33 accepts for identical shares; parcels and sales¶               →on the same day keep the order given. Each share is rounded to the cent so¶               →that the shares add up to the whole. Pass one class of shares or units in¶               →one company or fund, dated by contract, with parcels times sales at most¶               →1,000,000, units in millionths under 1,000,000,000 in all and amounts in¶               →whole cents. The loss uses the cost base too, so leave the third element,¶               →costs of owning, out of a parcel's cost base. Refused: a sale from 1 July¶               →2027, when the Treasury Laws Amendment (Tax Reform No. 1) Act 2026 changes¶               →CGT; a sale taking units from a parcel acquired on or before 21 September¶               →1999, which indexation or the pre-CGT rules can reach; and a sale of more¶               →units than are held by its date. Arithmetic only: it does not decide¶               →whether the entity can use the discount, adjust cost bases for returns of¶               →capital, bonus shares or rollovers, or select parcels. NetCapitalGainλ()¶               →takes its Gain, Loss and 12 months columns.¶" &
                            "WEBPAGE:       →https://github.com/ryanduguid/Ozzit/blob/main/docs/australian-modelling.md¶" &
                            "VERSION:       →22 Nov 2026¶" &
                            "PARAMETERS:    →¶" &
                            "Parcels        →(Required) One row a parcel: the date acquired, the units and the cost base in cents, without costs of owning.¶" &
                            "Sales          →(Required) One row a sale: the contract date, the units and the capital proceeds less selling costs, in cents.¶" &
                            "EXAMPLES:      →¶" &
                            "→Formula (oz is assumed to be the module's name)¶" &
                            "→=oz.CGTParcelsλ(VSTACK(HSTACK(DATE(2024,3,1), 1000, 5000), HSTACK(DATE(2025,3,3), 3000, 30000)), HSTACK(DATE(2026,3,2), 1500, 12000))¶" &
                            "→Result¶" &
                            "→Sold, Acquired, Units, Proceeds, Cost base, Gain, Loss, 12 months¶" &
                            "→2/03/2026, 1/03/2024, 1000, 8000.00, 5000.00, 3000.00, 0.00, TRUE¶" &
                            "→2/03/2026, 3/03/2025,  500, 4000.00, 5000.00,    0.00, 1000.00, FALSE",
                            "→", "¶"
                        )),
    //  Check inputs - Omitted required arguments
        Help?,          OR( ISOMITTED( Parcels), ISOMITTED( Sales)),
    //  Each table is 3 columns of numbers, with at most 1,000,000 pairs of a parcel and a
    //  sale so TOCOL's column holds them: whole-day dates; units in whole millionths, at least one, under 1E9 in
    //  all, so spans in millionths stay exact integers; and amounts in whole cents under
    //  1E10, a parcel's cost base not below 0. A sale's net proceeds may be below 0.
        Valid?,         LAMBDA( Table, Floor, IFERROR( AND( COLUMNS( Table) = 3,
                            AND( ISNUMBER( Table)),
                            AND( TAKE( Table, , 1) = INT( TAKE( Table, , 1)), TAKE( Table, , 1) >= 1),
                            AND( ROUND( CHOOSECOLS( Table, 2) * 1E6, 0) >= 1, SUM( CHOOSECOLS( Table, 2)) < 1E9),
                            AND( ABS( CHOOSECOLS( Table, 2) * 1E6 - ROUND( CHOOSECOLS( Table, 2) * 1E6, 0)) < 0.001),
                            AND( TAKE( Table, , -1) >= Floor, ABS( TAKE( Table, , -1)) < 1E10),
                            AND( ABS( TAKE( Table, , -1) * 100 - ROUND( TAKE( Table, , -1) * 100, 0)) < 0.001)), FALSE)),
        ValidParcels?,  Valid?( Parcels, 0),
        ValidSales?,    Valid?( Sales, -1E10),
        ValidPairs?,    IFERROR( ROWS( Parcels) * ROWS( Sales) <= 1000000, FALSE),
        TableMessage,   "Parcels and Sales must each be 3 columns of numbers, with at most 1,000,000 parcel and sale pairs: the date; the units, in millionths from 0.000001 and under 1,000,000,000 in all; and the parcel's cost base, 0 or more, or the sale's proceeds less its selling costs, in whole cents under 10,000,000,000.",
    //  Procedure - sort each table by date, keeping the order given on the same day
        PCount,         ROWS( Parcels),
        SCount,         ROWS( Sales),
        P,              CHOOSEROWS( Parcels, SORTBY( SEQUENCE( PCount), TAKE( Parcels, , 1), 1, SEQUENCE( PCount), 1)),
        S,              CHOOSEROWS( Sales, SORTBY( SEQUENCE( SCount), TAKE( Sales, , 1), 1, SEQUENCE( SCount), 1)),
        Acquired,       TAKE( P, , 1),
        Sold,           TAKE( S, , 1),
    //  Units in millionths and amounts in cents, as whole numbers
        PUnits,         ROUND( CHOOSECOLS( P, 2) * 1E6, 0),
        SUnits,         ROUND( CHOOSECOLS( S, 2) * 1E6, 0),
        PCents,         ROUND( TAKE( P, , -1) * 100, 0),
        SCents,         ROUND( TAKE( S, , -1) * 100, 0),
    //  Laid end to end in date order, each parcel and each sale is a span of units. A
    //  sale takes the units its span shares with each parcel's: first in, first out.
        PTo,            SCAN( 0, PUnits, LAMBDA( Total, Units, Total + Units)),
        PFrom,          PTo - PUnits,
        STo,            SCAN( 0, SUnits, LAMBDA( Total, Units, Total + Units)),
        SFrom,          STo - SUnits,
    //  So a sale may only take units acquired by its date
        Held,           MMULT( --( TRANSPOSE( Acquired) <= Sold), PUnits),
        Covered?,       AND( STo <= Held),
        CoverMessage,   "CGTParcelsλ refuses a sale of more units than the parcels acquired by its date.",
        Late?,          OR( Sold >= DATE( 2027, 7, 1)),
        LateMessage,    "CGTParcelsλ works sales before 1 July 2027: the Treasury Laws Amendment (Tax Reform No. 1) Act 2026 changes CGT from that day.",
    //  The spans each parcel shares with each sale, read sale by sale
        Low,            IF( PFrom > TRANSPOSE( SFrom), PFrom, TRANSPOSE( SFrom)),
        High,           IF( PTo < TRANSPOSE( STo), PTo, TRANSPOSE( STo)),
        Taken?,         TOCOL( High > Low, , TRUE),
        PAt,            FILTER( TOCOL( SEQUENCE( PCount) + 0 * SEQUENCE( 1, SCount), , TRUE), Taken?),
        SAt,            FILTER( TOCOL( SEQUENCE( 1, SCount) + 0 * SEQUENCE( PCount), , TRUE), Taken?),
        From,           FILTER( TOCOL( Low, , TRUE), Taken?),
        To,             FILTER( TOCOL( High, , TRUE), Taken?),
    //  A span's share of an amount is the difference of the rounded shares to its ends,
    //  so the shares of a parcel or a sale are each whole cents and add up to the whole.
        Share,          LAMBDA( Cents, Start, Units,
                            ROUND( Cents * ( To - Start) / Units, 0) - ROUND( Cents * ( From - Start) / Units, 0)),
        Cost,           Share( CHOOSEROWS( PCents, PAt), CHOOSEROWS( PFrom, PAt), CHOOSEROWS( PUnits, PAt)),
        Proceeds,       Share( CHOOSEROWS( SCents, SAt), CHOOSEROWS( SFrom, SAt), CHOOSEROWS( SUnits, SAt)),
        SoldOn,         CHOOSEROWS( Sold, SAt),
        AcquiredOn,     CHOOSEROWS( Acquired, PAt),
        Old?,           OR( AcquiredOn <= DATE( 1999, 9, 21)),
        OldMessage,     "CGTParcelsλ refuses a sale taking units from a parcel acquired on or before 21 September 1999: indexation or the pre-CGT rules can apply.",
    //  12 months from the day after acquisition, the day of the sale not counted. From
    //  29 February, DATE rolls to 1 March, where the 12 months end.
        Start,          AcquiredOn + 1,
        Twelve,         DATE( YEAR( Start) + 1, MONTH( Start), DAY( Start)),
        Gain,           IF( Proceeds > Cost, Proceeds - Cost, 0),
        Loss,           IF( Cost > Proceeds, Cost - Proceeds, 0),
        Result,         VSTACK( {"Sold", "Acquired", "Units", "Proceeds", "Cost base", "Gain", "Loss", "12 months"},
                            HSTACK( SoldOn, AcquiredOn, ( To - From) / 1E6, Proceeds / 100, Cost / 100, Gain / 100, Loss / 100, SoldOn >= Twelve)),
    //  Return Result, Help, or the message
        Return,         IF( Help?, 2, IF( NOT( AND( ValidParcels?, ValidSales?, ValidPairs?)), 3, IF( Late?, 4, IF( NOT( Covered?), 5, IF( Old?, 6, 1))))),
        CHOOSE( Return, Result, Help, TableMessage, LateMessage, CoverMessage, OldMessage)
    )
);
Net capital gain after capital losses and the CGT discount, for 2025-26 or 2026-27

/*  FUNCTION NAME:  NetCapitalGainλ
    DESCRIPTION:*//**Net capital gain for 2025-26 or 2026-27: capital losses reduce the gains, then the CGT discount applies*/
/*  SOURCE:         Income Tax Assessment Act 1997, compilation 264 (21 May 2026), volume 3, read 22 November 2026:
                    https://www.legislation.gov.au/C2004A05138/2026-05-21/2026-05-21/text/original/pdf/3
                    s 102-5(1): step 1 reduces the year's capital gains by its capital losses, step 2 by
                    unapplied net capital losses of earlier years, in the order you choose; step 3 reduces
                    each discount capital gain left by the discount percentage. s 102-10: losses above the
                    gains are a net capital loss. s 115-10: a company makes no discount capital gain.
                    s 115-100(a) and (b): 50% for an individual or trust, 33 1/3% for a complying
                    superannuation entity.
                    ATO, 'How to calculate your CGT', step 5, read 22 November 2026: subtract losses from gains
                    not eligible for the discount first:
                    https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/investments-and-assets/capital-gains-tax/calculating-your-cgt/how-to-calculate-your-cgt
                    Treasury Laws Amendment (Tax Reform No. 1) Act 2026 (No. 49, 2026), Schedule 1 item 82,
                    read 22 November 2026: its changes to Division 102 apply from the 2027-28 income year:
                    https://www.legislation.gov.au/C2026A00049/asmade/text
*/
NetCapitalGainλ = LAMBDA(
//  Parameter Declaration
    [IncomeYear],
    [Gains],
    [Discountable],
    [Losses],
    [PriorLosses],
    [Entity],
    LET(
    //  Help
        Help,           TRIM(TEXTSPLIT(
                            "FUNCTION:      →NetCapitalGainλ(IncomeYear, Gains, [Discountable], [Losses], [PriorLosses], [Entity])¶" &
                            "DESCRIPTION:   →Net capital gain after capital losses and the CGT discount.¶NOTES!         →Returns a header row and the year's net capital gain, the discount taken¶               →off it and the capital losses left to carry forward. The year's capital¶               →losses, then earlier years' net capital losses, reduce the gains not marked¶               →Discountable first, as the ATO advises; the Act lets you choose the order.¶               →The discount then takes 1/2 of each discount capital gain left for an¶               →individual or trust, 1/3 for a complying superannuation entity and nothing¶               →for a company (ITAA 1997 ss 102-5, 115-10 and 115-100). For the 2025-26 and¶               →2026-27 income years only: the Treasury Laws Amendment (Tax Reform No. 1)¶               →Act 2026 changes the method from 2027-28. Arithmetic only: the reviewer¶               →decides which gains are discount capital gains and which losses may reduce¶               →them. It does not apportion the discount for foreign or temporary¶               →residents, add the affordable housing discount, apply the small business¶               →concessions, or keep collectables' and personal use assets' losses apart.¶" &
                            "WEBPAGE:       →https://github.com/ryanduguid/Ozzit/blob/main/docs/australian-modelling.md¶" &
                            "VERSION:       →22 Nov 2026¶" &
                            "PARAMETERS:    →¶" &
                            "IncomeYear     →(Required) The year the income year ends: 2026 for 2025-26 or 2027 for 2026-27.¶" &
                            "Gains          →(Required) The year's capital gains in whole cents, each 0 or more. A blank is nil.¶" &
                            "Discountable   →(Optional: Default = FALSE) Cell for cell with Gains, TRUE or 1 for a discount capital gain.¶" &
                            "Losses         →(Optional: Default = 0) The year's capital losses.¶" &
                            "PriorLosses    →(Optional: Default = 0) Net capital losses of earlier years not yet applied.¶" &
                            "Entity         →(Optional: Default = ""I"") ""I"" individual, ""T"" trust, ""S"" complying superannuation entity or ""C"" company.¶" &
                            "EXAMPLES:      →¶" &
                            "→Formula (oz is assumed to be the module's name)¶" &
                            "→=oz.NetCapitalGainλ(2026, {3000;520}, {TRUE;FALSE}, 600, 400)¶" &
                            "→Result¶" &
                            "→Net capital gain, Discount, Losses carried forward¶" &
                            "→1260, 1260, 0",
                            "→", "¶"
                        )),
    //  Check inputs - Omitted required arguments
        Help?,          OR( ISOMITTED( IncomeYear), ISOMITTED( Gains)),
        ValidYear?,     IFERROR( AND( ROWS( IncomeYear) = 1, COLUMNS( IncomeYear) = 1, ISNUMBER( XMATCH( IncomeYear, {2026, 2027}, 0))), FALSE),
        YearMessage,    "IncomeYear must be 2026 for 2025-26 or 2027 for 2026-27: the Treasury Laws Amendment (Tax Reform No. 1) Act 2026 changes the method from 2027-28.",
    //  A blank Entity cell is not an omitted argument, so test for both
        Kind,           IF( ISOMITTED( Entity), "I", IF( TRIM( Entity & "") = "", "I", UPPER( TRIM( Entity)))),
        ValidEntity?,   IFERROR( AND( ROWS( Kind) = 1, COLUMNS( Kind) = 1, ISNUMBER( XMATCH( Kind, {"I", "T", "S", "C"}, 0))), FALSE),
        EntityMessage,  "Entity must be I (individual), T (trust), S (complying superannuation entity) or C (company).",
    //  Amounts are whole cents from 0 to under 1E10, or blank, which is nil. The sums are
    //  taken in cents, which stay exact integers while the gains, and the losses, are each
    //  under 1E13 in all.
        Amounts?,       LAMBDA( Values, IFERROR( AND( IF( ISNUMBER( Values),
                            ( Values >= 0) * ( Values < 1E10) * ( ABS( Values * 100 - ROUND( Values * 100, 0)) < 0.001),
                            TRIM( Values & "") = "")), FALSE)),
        Cents,          LAMBDA( Values, IF( ISNUMBER( Values), ROUND( Values * 100, 0), 0)),
        Total,          LAMBDA( Values, IF( ISOMITTED( Values), 0, SUM( Cents( Values)))),
        ValidAmounts?,  IF( AND( Amounts?( Gains), IF( ISOMITTED( Losses), TRUE, Amounts?( Losses)), IF( ISOMITTED( PriorLosses), TRUE, Amounts?( PriorLosses))),
                            AND( Total( Gains) < 1E15, Total( Losses) + Total( PriorLosses) < 1E15), FALSE),
        AmountMessage,  "Gains, Losses and PriorLosses must be whole cents from 0 to under 10,000,000,000, or blank, with the gains, and the losses, each under 10,000,000,000,000 in all.",
    //  Discountable matches Gains cell for cell: TRUE or 1 for a discount capital gain,
    //  FALSE, 0 or blank for any other
        Flag,           IF( ISOMITTED( Discountable), FALSE, IF( ISLOGICAL( Discountable), Discountable, IF( ISNUMBER( Discountable), Discountable = 1, FALSE))),
        ValidFlags?,    IF( ISOMITTED( Discountable), TRUE, IFERROR( AND( ROWS( Discountable) = ROWS( Gains), COLUMNS( Discountable) = COLUMNS( Gains),
                            AND( ISLOGICAL( Discountable) + ISNUMBER( Discountable) * ( ( Discountable = 0) + ( Discountable = 1)) + ( TRIM( Discountable & "") = ""))), FALSE)),
        FlagMessage,    "Discountable must match Gains cell for cell, each TRUE, FALSE, 1, 0 or blank.",
    //  Procedure - losses take the gains not eligible for the discount first (steps 1 and 2)
        Gain,           Cents( Gains),
        Eligible,       SUM( IF( Flag, Gain, 0)),
        Other,          SUM( IF( Flag, 0, Gain)),
        Applied,        Total( Losses) + Total( PriorLosses),
        OtherLeft,      MAX( 0, Other - Applied),
        LossLeft,       MAX( 0, Applied - Other),
        EligibleLeft,   MAX( 0, Eligible - LossLeft),
    //  Step 3: the discount percentage, a third or a half of the cents left
        Discount,       SWITCH( Kind, "S", EligibleLeft / 3, "C", 0, EligibleLeft / 2),
        Result,         VSTACK( {"Net capital gain", "Discount", "Losses carried forward"},
                            HSTACK( OtherLeft + EligibleLeft - Discount, Discount, MAX( 0, LossLeft - Eligible)) / 100),
    //  Return Result, Help, or the message
        Return,         IF( Help?, 2, IF( NOT( ValidYear?), 3, IF( NOT( ValidEntity?), 4, IF( NOT( ValidAmounts?), 5, IF( NOT( ValidFlags?), 6, 1))))),
        CHOOSE( Return, Result, Help, YearMessage, EntityMessage, AmountMessage, FlagMessage)
    )
);

Financial: "FinanceCompareλ    →Present value of each option's cash flows, such as a lease, hire purchase or loan, pre-tax¶"
